# AUTHORED INPUT, committed. Not a results file. The harness writes
# columns and `planted`/`outcome`/`altitude` filled; that generated file is the
# only thing the driving session reads (R5, EX-14).
# SOURCE OF TRUTH for `expected-stage`/`expected-token` is design.md § 5.6 —
# the re-derivation against the four-stage model. It is NOT probe-specs.md's
# inherited expected-kill column, which was authored against a pipeline tail
# this design removes; five rows there name machinery the design deletes or
#   row             H1..H16, the § 5.6 rows. Sixteen, and only sixteen.
#   mechanism       fetch (M-A) | bundle (M-B) — the pipeline's own literal, so
#                   the harness passes it through with no translation table
#   harness         pipeline | conflict | both (§ 5.1). `both` means the row
#                   ALSO carries a conflict sub-probe leg: run once per row
#                   against F3, scored as a separate entry, and counting toward
#                   nothing — it is an incumbent-layer regression check, not
#   vector-class    CPT-001's classes: 1 explicit execution · 2 build-system
#                   · 4 path-shaped data · 5 resource shape. `-` means this
#                   row's vector is not an interpretation-surface trigger at
#                   ASM-007 (exhaustiveness) is invalidated; the taxonomy is
#                   not. Do not add a sixth class here.
#   instantiation   what this cell plants, in this fixture. For a cell that is
#                   `n/a` up front, this carries the REASON, and the reason
#                   names a STRUCTURAL absence — never "not attempted" (R-C).
#   expected-stage  harvest | conform | verify | advance | dissolution.
#                   `dissolution` is first-class and distinct from empty (R-D):
#                   the row has no refusing stage BY CONSTRUCTION, which is the
#                   design's best result, not a gap.
#   expected-token  from the CLOSED vocabulary (§ 5.1, `token_legal` in
#                   control/pipeline.sh). Empty means no refusal is expected.
#   planted         EMPTY here. The harness fills it from `Hnn.planted?`, the
#                   per-cell positive control (F-7) — except where the cell is
#   outcome         EMPTY here. pass | partial | fail | n/a, DERIVED by the
#                   harness from the assertions the row actually made.
#   altitude        EMPTY here, ALWAYS. model-level | client-local |
#                   VA-1) — an authored value would make "generated, not
# `|` in an expected-* cell is an ALTERNATION, not a literal: every alternative
# must be observed by one of the row's legs, and each must itself be legal.
# It appears where § 5.6's re-derived boundary names more than one for a single
# row — H8 (two tree-mode tokens), H9 (two parts, scored as two), H13 (four
# 16 rows x 2 fixtures x 2 mechanisms = 64 cells, of which 4 are `n/a` up front
# (H12 on light, H13 on fetch) => 60 live cells.
